title: Physical details
description: The physical form of a waste item, how it is contained, and its total weight. All four are required. Loose waste (containerType LOO) has a containerCount of 0; any other container type needs at least one container.

containerCount.description: Must be 0 when the waste is loose (containerType LOO).
Must be at least 1 unless the waste is loose (containerType LOO).

form.description: The physical form of the waste. Case-sensitive.

containerType.description: Code for how the waste is contained. LOO means the waste is loose, with no containers. Case-sensitive.

containerCount.description: The number of containers: a whole number of 0 or more. Must be 0 when containerType is LOO, and at least 1 for any other container type.

totalWeight.description: The total weight of the waste item.
